purpose: Product-neutral milestone-2 design fixture; symbolic bindings, not a production context.

artifacts.summary: Canceled switches return focus to the initiating selector.

evidence.summary: Direct inspection of the two synthetic source observations.
Use staged replacement and a job lifetime independent of navigation; worker placement remains unselected.

binding.question: Who owns replacement and background task lifetime?
binding.rationale: Accept ownership advice; retain placement as an unselected option.

evidence.summary: Parent selects internal ownership within accepted behavior and leaves close policy to the owner.

binding.instruction: Select deferred replacement and independent job ownership; do not select shutdown policy or worker placement.

records.title: Starter observation
records.summary: The inspected fixture has a notebook selector but no persistent report runner.

details.claim: src/notebook.js changes a displayed name; src/report.js returns an in-memory string.
details.limits: This says nothing about target persistence or real platform support.

records.title: Deferred install
records.summary: Keep the original notebook until the replacement is validated.

details.context: Switching can encounter unsaved edits and an invalid candidate.
details.choice: The transition owner stages the candidate; the notebook authority installs it only after validation.

alternatives.option: Clear the current notebook before reading the candidate

consequences: Candidate reads cannot mutate current authority.

authority.basis: Allocates internal responsibility within the accepted preservation behavior.

records.title: Independent job
records.summary: The report operation owns its lifetime independently of the visible panel.

details.context: A saved-summary report continues while navigating between panels.
details.choice: A job authority retains the saved input, progress and output resources until completion or acknowledged cancellation.

alternatives.option: Let the report panel own the task
alternatives.reason: Panel disposal would violate navigation continuity.

consequences: The UI observes the operation instead of owning it.

authority.basis: Internal ownership satisfies the accepted navigation requirement; application shutdown is unresolved.

records.title: Notebook authority
records.summary: Own the current notebook and perform its final replacement.

details.responsibility: Current notebook identity and saved data.
details.failureBehavior: Failed candidate validation leaves the current notebook unchanged.

details.responsibility: Guard order, candidate validation and one final installation.
details.lifecycle: One operation; retains prior context until outcome.
details.failureBehavior: Cancel or failed validation stops the transition without discarding the current notebook.

records.title: Report job
records.summary: Own a report attempt based on saved input.

details.responsibility: Saved input identity, progress, cancellation and output resource cleanup.
exchanges: Attempt identity, saved input, output result
details.lifecycle: Outlives panel navigation; ends after completion or acknowledged cancellation.
details.failureBehavior: Failure retains request inputs and never claims the report is complete.

records.title: Switch flow
records.summary: Switch after guard resolution and candidate validation.

preconditions: Current notebook and pending selection are captured.

steps.result: Continue or stop without installing a candidate.

steps.action: Read and validate the chosen candidate.

steps.result: New current identity; release the old state after success.

failure: A read or validation failure preserves the original notebook and draft.
details.cancellation: Cancel retains current state and returns focus to the initiating selector.
details.retry: A retry starts a new captured attempt; no deferred request is replayed silently.
guarantees: Final installation is the only authority transition.
limits: Durable file-save mechanics are outside this flow.
verification: Walk through a successful guard, candidate read and one final install.

records.title: Close policy gap
records.summary: Closing with an active report requires an owner decision.

details.question: Should application close wait, cancel, or offer a decision while a report is active?
resolutionCriteria: Owner selects visible behavior after a bounded lifetime feasibility assessment.

records.title: Report flow
records.summary: Create a report from saved input and retain progress across panel navigation.

details.trigger: Choose a saved inventory summary and request a report.
preconditions: Input refers to a saved revision rather than a draft.

steps.action: Capture the saved input and start one attempt.
steps.result: Stable attempt identity and owned resources.

steps.action: Build the report while publishing progress.
steps.result: Completion result or an explicit failure.

success: Completed report is identified to the caller.
failure: Incomplete output is never reported as complete; resource cleanup belongs to the job.
details.cancellation: Remain active until the job acknowledges cancellation and releases resources.
details.retry: A fresh attempt revalidates input and destination.
guarantees: Panel navigation does not own job lifetime.
limits: Application-close behavior remains unresolved; no shutdown guarantee is made.
verification: Start from a saved revision, navigate panels and observe completion of the same attempt.

records.title: Worker option
records.summary: A worker is an unselected placement option.

details.context: The eventual report workload might occupy the interface thread.
details.choice: Consider a worker only after measuring the representative workload.

alternatives.option: Run a bounded task in the existing process
alternatives.reason: No timing evidence selects either placement.

consequences: No worker API or process boundary is accepted by this fixture.

authority.basis: Records an option for later assessment, not authorization to implement it.
